sources.title: Claude Platform release notes — June 20th, 2024
sources.evidence: The June 20, 2024 entry explicitly announces Claude Sonnet 3.5 availability on the Claude API, Amazon Bedrock and Vertex AI. This is primary day-level release evidence. Its November 13, 2024 entry explicitly adds PDF support for all Sonnet 3.5 models, including this June revision.

sources.title: Introducing Claude 3.5 Sonnet
sources.evidence: Original-release announcement identifies Anthropic's first Claude 3.5 model, a 200K context window, vision capability, and writing/editing/executing code with provided tools. The current page displays June 21, 2024, conflicting with the June 20 release-note entry.

sources.title: Claude 3.5 Sonnet Model Card Addendum
sources.evidence: The original eight-page addendum identifies Claude 3.5 Sonnet as an evolution of Claude 3, and reports vision and agentic coding evaluations. It does not disclose total/active parameter counts or dense/MoE architecture.

sources.title: Model Card Addendum: Claude 3.5 Haiku and Upgraded Claude 3.5 Sonnet
sources.evidence: Later comparison tables explicitly separate Claude 3.5 Sonnet from Claude 3.5 Sonnet (New). Tables 2–5 cover the original model's agentic coding, API/tool-use and vision results, but provide no parameter or architecture specifications. The new computer-use feature belongs to the upgraded model.

sources.title: Claude 3.7 Sonnet System Card
sources.evidence: Section 1.2 says Claude 3.7 Sonnet introduces extended thinking, with a separate reasoning section and configurable thinking budget. The inspected later family card does not disclose the June Claude 3.5 Sonnet's total/active parameters or architecture; newer-model specifications are not transferred.

sources.title: Anthropic's Claude 3.5 Sonnet model now available in Amazon Bedrock
sources.evidence: Dated June 20, 2024. The release example uses anthropic.claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620-v1:0, submits text and image content, and reads text output. This links the original launch and modalities to the exact June revision.

sources.title: Commercial Terms of Service
sources.evidence: The accessed terms, effective June 17, 2025, govern Anthropic API services, grant service-use permission, prohibit duplication/reverse engineering and reserve intellectual-property rights. They support proprietary hosted-service classification rather than an open-weight license; they are not the launch-day terms.

sources.title: Model deprecations — Claude Sonnet 3.5 models
sources.evidence: Explicitly lists claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620 separately from the October revision and gives October 28, 2025 as its Claude API retirement date. It also uses the friendly name Claude Sonnet 3.5.

sources.title: The Claude 3 Model Family: Opus, Sonnet, Haiku — combined card
sources.evidence: The web fetch failed because the 46,824,360-byte document exceeded its content-length limit. No technical conclusions rely on this inaccessible combined copy; the original June and October standalone addenda were accessible.

sources.title: Responsible Scaling Policy, Version 1.0
sources.evidence: ASL-2 containment measures protect model weights as core intellectual property, restrict access by job function and prevent unsanctioned release. The exact June Sonnet 3.5 addendum explicitly classifies that model as ASL-2, supplying model-specific scope.

sources.title: Claude Model Pricing — List Prices by Platform, effective May 12, 2026
sources.evidence: Parent reviewed page3: the May12,2026 API pricing table lists 200K and 1M rows for Claude 3.5 Sonnet (without specifying June or October revision). These rows postdate Anthropic API retirement and conflict with retained exact-model context specifications; no corroborating availability announcement was found.

name.note: The current official release notes and retirement listing use this ordering; the launch title uses Claude 3.5 Sonnet. The dated model ID distinguishes the June snapshot.

developer.note: Anthropic is the announcing developer and model-card author.

family.note: The launch belongs to Claude 3.5, within the broader Claude family represented by this catalog key.

release_date.note: Retain June 20: Anthropic's dated API release entry and AWS's exact-revision launch agree. The announcement page currently labels itself June 21; record that conflict rather than shifting the earliest public availability.

open_weights.note: The exact June model card classifies this model as ASL-2, whose contemporaneous policy restricts model-weight access and protects against unsanctioned release. Proprietary terms support the classification; API hosting alone is not the basis.

license.note: Descriptive license classification for the hosted service, not the name of a downloadable-weight license. The accessed 2025 commercial terms grant service access under proprietary restrictions.

parameters_b.note: No exact-model count is disclosed in the original addendum or the inspected later family cards. The October card's separately labeled original-model comparison columns contain evaluation scores, not parameter counts.

active_parameters_b.note: No active-parameter count or routing structure is disclosed for the June revision. Do not infer equality with a total count or transfer a sibling model's specification.

architecture.note: The inspected first-party cards do not establish dense versus MoE or a detailed exact-revision architecture. Keep null rather than asserting an inferred decoder-only Transformer configuration.

context_window.note: The original announcement explicitly specifies a 200K-token context window. A later post-retirement pricing table also lists a conflicting 1M API tier; retain 200K from exact-model documentation because the pricing row does not establish feature availability.

modalities.note: Original vision evaluation and exact June-revision examples establish text/image input and text output. November 13 release notes add PDF support for all Sonnet 3.5 models; the catalog records later documented capability.

reasoning.note: False denotes absence of a dedicated extended-thinking/reasoning mode, not inability to solve reasoning tasks or emit prompted chain-of-thought. The October card distinguishes its models from pre-response-compute reasoning models; the 3.7 card explicitly introduces extended thinking later.

tool_call.note: The original launch describes tool-enabled execution. The later card separately evaluates original Claude 3.5 Sonnet in TAU-bench API/tool interactions, confirming this is not a capability transferred from the October upgrade.

description.value: Original June 2024 Claude 3.5 Sonnet release, with a 200,000-token context window, text and image inputs, text output, and tool calling.
description.note: Replaces a generic historical-release placeholder with supported distinguishing capabilities; excludes performance superlatives and the October model's new computer-use capability.

patch.description: Original June 2024 Claude 3.5 Sonnet release, with a 200,000-token context window, text and image inputs, text output, and tool calling.
patch.notes: Total and active parameter counts and detailed architecture are undisclosed in the inspected first-party cards. This is the June snapshot, distinct from claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022. Anthropic's release notes establish June 20, 2024 despite the current announcement page displaying June 21. Anthropic documents Claude API retirement on October 28, 2025. PDF support was added November 13, 2024 for all Sonnet 3.5 models. A May 12, 2026 pricing PDF lists a conflicting 1M API tier after retirement; retained exact-model specifications support 200K.

Anthropic later pricing table with conflicting context tier

summary: Reviewed all 14 fields for the June 20 revision. Confirmed identity, developer/family, earliest release date, proprietary hosted status, 200K context and text/image-to-text modalities. Added tool calling and absence of dedicated extended thinking, and replaced the generic description. Total/active parameters and architecture remain undisclosed after inspecting original and later first-party cards, including separate original-model comparison columns. Recorded the announcement-date discrepancy and exact Claude API retirement; no October-revision specifications were transferred. Parent confirmed ASL-2 weight restrictions and added the later documented PDF support.
